label: unrun
scenario: Must reject a citation that is real but supports a different claim. Claim C-04 v1 (type fact): 'Reply Assist never sends a reply without human review.' The citation is S-policy v3, section 4, a real section of the controlling policy stating 'All drafts are logged with the reviewing agent's id for 90 days.' Section 2 of the same policy, not cited, contains the drafts-only statement.

input_refs.title: C-04 v1 never sends without human review
S-policy v3 section 4 (logging of reviewer ids)

checks: The verdict is insufficient_evidence with a different_claim mismatch, despite the source being the controlling policy and the section concerning review.
different_claim_supported states the logging proposition that section 4 does assert.
supported_variant is null, because no narrower form of the sending claim is carried by section 4.
requested_followups points the author to S-policy v3 section 2 as the next citation to assess, without the checker rewriting the ledger.
